|{{WEGCite|book=Classic Adventures: Volume Four — The Best of the Journal|story=Relic (article)}} establishes that the [[Kashi Mer talisman]] was present during&mdash;and also survived&mdash;the destruction of the [[Kashi system]], including [[Kashi]], shortly after the [[Galactic Constitution Conference|formation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' dates to [[25,053 BBY]]. {{CSWECite|II|201|Kashi Mer}} further states that, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[First Great Schism]]&mdash;dated to [[24,500 BBY]] by {{CSWECite|I|xi|A Timeline of Galactic Events}}&mdash;the [[Star system/Legends|star system's]] [[Kashi Mer]] culture had not yet gone extinct as a result of its destruction. Finally, {{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}} establishes that [[Arden Lyn]] had the talisman in her possession from the First Great Schism up until her revival from stasis, which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates to [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]]. Therefore, the Kashi system must have been destroyed at some point by 24,500 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].
